title: Rabbi Yose bar Abaye
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5, folio 20a, Rabbi Yochanan reports Rabbi Yose bar Abaye: the tablets sought to fly away, and Moshe held them fast. In Zevachim 96a, Rabbi Yochanan reports Abba Yose ben Abba; at 25b he reports Rabbi Yose bar Abba. Hyman suggests they are all the same person.

notes.text: The additional 20a is a folio locator, not an extra halakhah. Abaye, Abba and Abba Yose ben Abba remain the supplied forms, with their possible identification attributed to Hyman.
